## 中文

### 主要变化

- **三种工作模式**：设置页新增“工作模式”，可选“仅 Zotero 存储”“外部链接”“Zotero 存储 + 外部副本”。
  - 外部链接：即以前的“链接”附加类型，附件移到你自己的目录，由网盘同步。
  - Zotero 存储 + 外部副本（新）：附件仍由 Zotero 存储和同步，同时在外部目录保留一份按规则整理的副本，副本只从 Zotero 单向更新，外部改过的副本不会被覆盖。
- **设置页重构**：分为工作模式、附件命名与目录、下载文件夹、自动处理、快捷键几个折叠区；目录状态实时校验，并提供输出路径预览。
- **多个下载文件夹**：“附加新文件”取所有文件夹中最新的文件，“匹配附件”按顺序查找。
- **下载文件夹源文件删除**改为独立选项“附加或匹配成功后删除下载文件夹中的源文件”。
- **更安全的文件操作**：复制后校验再发布，从不覆盖已有文件；转换为链接附件时还会迁移回收站中的标注和子笔记；群组文库不再尝试转换。
- **Zotero 11**：右键菜单改用官方 MenuManager 注册。

### 修复

- 开启自动移动时，“撤销移动附件”恢复的附件会立刻被移回外部目录。
- 副本模式下，若下载文件夹就是副本目录，“匹配 Attanger 附件”会多写一份 `name_1` 文件；现在内容相同的文件会直接作为副本。
- “匹配 Attanger 附件”无法识别 `pdf, docx` 这类带空格的文件类型。
- 手动命令使用的“当前分类”可能被之后的自动处理沿用。
- “从 PDF 读取标题”的 CJK 判断现在包含日文假名和韩文。

### 升级须知

- **设置会自动迁移，无需操作**：以前是“链接”并设置了目标路径的，自动成为“外部链接”，自动移动、保留原始文件等选项含义不变；其他情况成为“仅 Zotero 存储”。“外部副本”模式需要手动选择。
- **切换模式不会改动已有附件**。需要整理时，选中条目后右键使用“移动附件”或“同步外部副本”。
- **“保留原始文件”现在只用于链接附件的移动**，名称改为“保留链接附件的原始文件（移动变为复制）”；下载文件夹是否删除源文件由新选项控制，迁移时已按旧设置取反填好。
- 手动移动遇到同名文件时，不再弹出 3 秒的“自定义后缀”提示，直接自动加 `_1`、`_2`。
- 外部 PDF 副本不包含 Zotero 中的标注（标注保存在 Zotero 数据库中）。
- 完整说明见 [README](https://github.com/MuiseDestiny/zotero-attanger/blob/main/doc/README-zhCN.md)。

---

## English

### Highlights

- **Three work modes**: a new **Work Mode** setting offers **Zotero Storage Only**, **External Links**, and **Zotero Storage + External Copy**.
  - External Links is the former "Link" attach type: attachments move to your own folder, synced by a cloud drive.
  - Zotero Storage + External Copy (new): attachments stay in Zotero storage and sync, and an organized copy is kept in an external folder. Copies update one way from Zotero; a copy edited outside Zotero is never overwritten.
- **Redesigned settings**: collapsible sections for Work Mode, Attachment Names and Folders, Download Folder, Automatic Processing, and Keyboard Shortcuts, with live directory checks and an output path preview.
- **Multiple download folders**: Attach New File takes the newest file across all folders; Match Attachment searches them in order.
- **Deleting download-folder files** is now its own option, "Delete the file from the download folder after attaching or matching it".
- **Safer file handling**: files are verified before publishing and existing files are never overwritten; converting to linked attachments also transfers trashed annotations and child notes; group libraries are no longer converted.
- **Zotero 11**: context menus are registered through the official MenuManager.

### Fixes

- With automatic moving on, attachments restored by **Undo Move Attachment** were immediately moved out again.
- In copy mode, when the download folder was the copy directory, **Match Attanger Attachment** wrote an extra `name_1` file; an identical file is now adopted as the copy.
- **Match Attanger Attachment** did not accept file types with spaces, such as `pdf, docx`.
- The collection selected for a manual command could leak into later automatic processing.
- The CJK check in **Read title from PDF** now includes Japanese kana and Korean.

### Upgrade notes

- **Settings migrate automatically**: if you used "Link" with a destination path, you get **External Links** and your automatic-move and keep-original options keep their meaning; otherwise you get **Zotero Storage Only**. Choose **External Copy** yourself if you want it.
- **Switching modes never changes existing attachments.** To organize them, select the items and use **Move Attachment** or **Sync External Copy**.
- **"Keep original files" now only affects moving linked attachments** and is renamed "Keep original files of linked attachments (move becomes copy)". Download-folder deletion has its own option, pre-filled from your old setting.
- Manual moves no longer show the 3-second "custom suffix" prompt on a name clash; `_1`, `_2`, ... are added automatically.
- External PDF copies do not contain Zotero annotations, which live in the Zotero database.
- See the [README](https://github.com/MuiseDestiny/zotero-attanger#readme) for details.
